title: Social Remit canonical error catalogue
notes: Codes are stable forever. A code is never repurposed; retired codes are marked deprecated and left in place.
The server never sends customer prose. It sends copyKey; the client resolves copy for the active locale.
No provider (FinCode, MTO, AWS, SMS gateway) error text or code may appear in any field of an API error.
details carries only non-sensitive metadata. Never attemptsUsed with the submitted value, never the destination in full.

errors.clientTreatment: Hard block with store link. No other call is made.
Show maintenance screen with Help access retained.
Route to registration. Rates and services are not available before phone verification and passcode setup.
Start a new registration journey. Previously verified facts are preserved server-side.
Re-fetch GET /v1/journeys/{id} and render the returned state. Never continue on client assumption.
Clear the field, keep the challenge, show attemptsRemaining.
Offer resend. Server timestamps are authoritative, not the client countdown.
A newer code was issued. Prompt for the latest code.
Challenge invalidated — NOT the account. Offer a new code.
Display the server countdown. Do not compute locally.
Back off. Message must not reveal whether the number exists.
Clear the confirmation entry only, keep the first entry.
Show the safe reason category and hint. Never reveal the blocked list.
Clear input; render attemptsRemaining and cooldown metadata.
Show server countdown. Offer Reset Passcode. Never a permanent lock.
Route to the new-device flow with the exact factors named in details.
Render the requested method options; re-issue the original request after success.
Silent refresh, then recognised-device sign-in. Do not clear entered form data.
Route to another approved recovery method. An unverified email never satisfies recovery.
Route to assisted recovery. No automatic bypass exists.
Safe status screen with Help. No detail about the risk signal.
Safe status and Help route only.
Developer error: same key, different body. Client must generate a new key per distinct intent.
Original request is still running. Retry the same key after retryAfterSeconds.
Field-level messages from fieldErrors; no server prose.
Generic retry. Never name the failing internal service or provider.
Downstream projection not yet caught up. Poll GET /v1/journeys/{id}. MUST NOT re-submit credentials.
